verses.translation: May the hands of Abu Lahab perish, and he ˹himself˺ perish

verses.arabicText: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
verses.transliteration: Mā aghnā ʿanhu māluhu wamā kasab
verses.translation: Neither his wealth nor ˹worldly˺ gains will benefit him
He will burn in a flaming Fire
and ˹so will˺ his wife, the carrier of ˹thorny˺ kindling
around her neck will be a rope of palm-fibre
